start: Admin app, Settings, card "Alerts from your members", this browser has alerts off

steps.action: Tap "Turn on alerts on this device" and allow notifications in the browser
user_sees: Alerts shown as on for this device
must_not: Another browser of the gym turned on or off
Alerts shown as on when the address was not saved

steps.action: Pick "Daily summary" at 11:00 am and save
user_sees: The card keeps Daily summary at 11:00 am after a reload
must_not: A summary sent twice for the same day after the change
The setting saved for another gym

start: Alerts card, alerts on for this browser, setting Daily summary

steps.action: Change the setting to instant and save
user_sees: The card shows instant
must_not: Alerts still held for the daily summary

steps.action: A member sends a message that makes a gym alert; close the admin app and wait a minute
user_sees: A browser pop-up "MettleUp: news from your members" with the alert line
must_not: The pop-up shows a member phone number
The same alert pops up twice

start: Alerts card, alerts off; the browser blocks notifications or sends a bad address

steps.action: Tap "Turn on alerts on this device" and refuse the browser permission
user_sees: Alerts stay off with a plain word why
must_not: Alerts shown as on
A browser address saved without its keys

steps.action: Save a summary time outside the day (a broken request)
user_sees: The save is refused and the old setting stays
must_not: A half-saved setting
A summary sent at a wrong time

start: Alerts card, alerts on for this browser

steps.action: Turn alerts off for this device
user_sees: Alerts shown as off for this device
must_not: Other browsers of the gym turned off
More pop-ups reach this browser

steps.action: Turn alerts on again
user_sees: Alerts shown as on; the next alert pops up once
must_not: Old alerts from while it was off all pop up at once

start: Owner, desk and a trainer each turned alerts on in their own browser

steps.action: A member sends a complaint to "Gym owner"
user_sees: Only the owner browser shows the pop-up
must_not: The trainer or the desk browser shows the complaint
The pop-up carries the member phone number

start: Desk person signed in to the admin app, Settings, "Alerts from your members"

steps.action: Tap "Turn on alerts on this device" and allow notifications
user_sees: Alerts shown as on for this device
The gym setting shown read-only
must_not: The desk able to change instant, daily or weekly
The owner browser turned off

start: Desk person on the alerts card

steps.action: Try to change the summary setting (an older screen or a forged request)
user_sees: The change is refused: only the owner may change it
must_not: The gym setting changed by the desk

start: Desk person has alerts on; the owner then removes the person

steps.action: Owner removes the desk person in Staff & sign-in; within a minute an alert is made
user_sees: No pop-up reaches the removed person browser
must_not: A removed person still gets member news

steps.action: A member sends a complaint to "Gym owner", then another to "Gym admin"
user_sees: Only the "Gym admin" complaint pops up on the desk browser
must_not: The complaint to "Gym owner" pops up for the desk

start: Trainer signed in to the admin app, Settings, "Alerts from your members"

steps.action: Tap "Turn on alerts on this device" and allow notifications
user_sees: Alerts shown as on for this device
must_not: The trainer able to change the summary setting

steps.action: Try to save the summary setting (a forged request)
user_sees: The change is refused: only the owner may change it
must_not: The gym setting changed by a trainer

steps.action: Turn alerts off for this device, then a member asks this trainer a question
user_sees: No pop-up on this browser; the question is in the list
must_not: A pop-up after alerts were turned off

steps.action: A member sends feedback and a complaint to "Gym admin"
user_sees: No pop-up on the trainer browser
must_not: Feedback or a complaint reaching a trainer

start: HQ Worker run each minute; a gym has an urgent alert and two browsers that may see it

steps.action: The Worker asks for what to send now
user_sees: Two pushes come back, one per browser, and the alert is marked sent at once
must_not: The same alert handed out on the next run
A push for a browser whose sign-in ended

start: A gym on Daily summary at 11:00 am with three waiting alerts

steps.action: At the slot the Worker lists gyms due and takes this gym summary
user_sees: Each browser gets one push "3 new updates from your members. Open the admin app to see them."
All three alerts marked digest
must_not: A push to a browser that may see none of the three

start: Alerts waiting longer than 6 hours (instant) or 8 days (summary)

steps.action: The Worker runs
user_sees: The old alerts are marked late and never sent
must_not: A stale alert popping up hours later
Anyone but the HQ service calling the job

start: A summary slot already taken by an earlier run

steps.action: A retry of the same slot runs
user_sees: claimed false and nothing sent
must_not: A second summary for the same slot

steps.action: The push company answers that a browser address is gone
user_sees: The address is dropped
must_not: The dead address tried again every minute

start: A gym with an owner browser and a trainer browser

steps.action: The Worker builds pushes for a member complaint
user_sees: Only browsers whose person may see the alert get it
must_not: The push body carrying a phone number
A trainer browser getting a complaint
